expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsTable component with table, bulk actions bar, pagination, and mock mutation functions provided in full

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Entire response is working TypeScript/React code with no recommendation sections

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete only uses `window.confirm()` dialog with no undo/recovery mechanism. Checklist specifically requires 'rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone'

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar displays `{selectedIds.size} selected` before any action buttons

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Bulkbar shows: '{selectedIds.size} selected {totalCount > pageSize && ` of ${totalCount} total`}' — displays both page selection and total count

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive: 'text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300'. Delete: 'text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 border border-red-300' — distinct color treatment

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button appears first; Delete uses red but equivalent visual weight and styling pattern

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: No mention of server-side validation or enforcement of authorization rules

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closes with feature list and 'Replace archiveDocuments and deleteDocuments with actual API calls' — does not name any prevented misuses
